deficiency.overview: This source does not establish a saturated-fat deficiency diagnosis or a separate personal minimum requirement.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: FDA describes replacing saturated fat with unsaturated fat in relation to lower LDL cholesterol. The replacement context matters; no individual disease-risk prediction is made.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Individual clinical or medical assessment requires a qualified professional.
